response: Micro-computed tomography (micro-CT) is a reliable technique to determine the bone density and the microstructure of the maxillary alveolar bone at the site of dental implant insertion. The bone volume to tissue volume (BV/TV) ratio assessed by micro-CT correlates with the percentage of bone assessed by conventional stereologic-based histomorphometry, making it a reliable method for evaluating the microstructure of the maxillary alveolar bone.
